enlist_duty.reason: Built at run time as "taom_enlist_duty_" + id + "_" + suffix. The duty JSON names the title, body and option keys as literals; the success and failure keys are never written out, only composed for the result toast.

character_creation_narrative.reason: Built as $"{{=taom_cc_{StringId}_text}}" and "_desc" for each option in the charactercreation JSON files, whose StringId values start with taom_ (taom_parent_gondor_1 and so on); the ids appear in the JSON without the taom_cc_ prefix.

siege_defense.reason: Built as "taom_siege_defense_" + kingdom id + "_" + field for each entry of siege/siege_defense_config.json, whose KingdomMessages keys are the kingdom ids; the default and Ignore rows are C# literals.

special_resource_name.reason: Built as "taom_res_name_" + resource id for each display_name of special_resources/special_resources_config.xml.

special_resource_tier.reason: Built as "taom_res_tier_" + resource id + "_" + tier level + "_name" or "_desc" for each Tier of special_resources/special_resources_config.xml.
